mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_browser_call_receipts(tenant_id,end_user_id,invocation_id,task_id,session_id,run_id,operation,status,public_receipt) VALUES(#{tenant},#{user},#{invocation},#{task},#{session},#{run},#{operation},#{status},CAST(#{payload} AS jsonb)) ON CONFLICT(tenant_id,end_user_id,invocation_id) DO UPDATE SET status=EXCLUDED.status, task_id=EXCLUDED.task_id,public_receipt=EXCLUDED.public_receipt,updated_at=now() WHERE nw_browser_call_receipts.operation=EXCLUDED.operation AND nw_browser_call_receipts.run_id=EXCLUDED.run_id
